sentences.english: The game is over.
sentences.chinese: 比赛结束了。

sentences.english: Can you come over to my house after school?
sentences.chinese: 放学后你能来我家吗？

sentences.english: I knocked over a glass of water and it spilled all over my notebook, so I had to rewrite my homework.
sentences.chinese: 我打翻了一杯水，洒得笔记本上到处都是，只好重写作业。
sentences.scene: 不小心打翻水的尴尬经历

sentences.english: The kid is playing outside.
sentences.chinese: 那个小孩在外面玩。

sentences.english: When I was a kid, I used to climb trees all the time.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候经常爬树。

sentences.english: My little brother is such a funny kid; he told me a joke today that made me laugh so hard I almost cried.
sentences.chinese: 我弟弟是个特别搞笑的小孩，今天他给我讲了个笑话，笑得我眼泪都快出来了。
sentences.scene: 被弟弟的笑话逗得前仰后合

sentences.english: What's for dinner tonight?
sentences.chinese: 今晚吃什么？

sentences.english: We usually have dinner around seven o'clock when Dad gets home.
sentences.chinese: 我们通常在爸爸到家后七点左右吃晚饭。

sentences.english: For my birthday dinner, I asked my mom to make her famous lasagna, and she even let me help layer the cheese.
sentences.chinese: 生日晚餐我让妈妈做了她拿手的千层面，她还让我帮忙铺奶酪。
sentences.scene: 生日时和家人一起准备特别晚餐

sentences.english: I love art class.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢美术课。

sentences.english: My sister is really good at art; she can draw anything.
sentences.chinese: 我姐姐很擅长美术，她什么都能画。

sentences.english: I never thought I was any good at art until my teacher showed me how to use watercolors, and now it's my favorite hobby.
sentences.chinese: 我以前从没觉得自己会画画，直到老师教我用水彩，现在它成了我最喜欢的爱好。
sentences.scene: 发现绘画天赋并爱上水彩

sentences.english: Let's have lunch together.
sentences.chinese: 我们一起吃午饭吧。

sentences.english: I packed a sandwich and an apple for lunch today.
sentences.chinese: 我今天午餐带了三明治和一个苹果。

sentences.english: During lunch break, we always sit under the big tree in the schoolyard and share snacks while complaining about homework.
sentences.chinese: 午休时，我们总是坐在学校操场的大树下，一边分享零食一边抱怨作业。
sentences.scene: 校园午餐时光的固定聚会

sentences.english: I have maths class next.
sentences.chinese: 我下一节是数学课。

sentences.english: Maths is difficult for me, but my dad helps me with my homework.
sentences.chinese: 数学对我来说很难，但我爸爸会辅导我作业。
sentences.scene: 表达数学难但有家人帮助

sentences.english: I used to hate maths, but after my teacher explained fractions using pizza slices, it suddenly made sense.
sentences.chinese: 我以前讨厌数学，但老师用披萨片解释了分数后，我突然就懂了。
sentences.scene: 通过生动例子爱上数学

sentences.english: I get up at seven.
sentences.chinese: 我七点起床。

sentences.english: It's hard to get up early on cold winter mornings.
sentences.chinese: 在寒冷的冬天早晨很难早起。

sentences.english: My alarm didn't go off, so I didn't get up until my mom came in and said I was going to miss the bus.
sentences.chinese: 我的闹钟没响，直到妈妈进来说我赶不上校车了，我才起床。

sentences.english: I go to school by bus.
sentences.chinese: 我坐公交车上学。

sentences.english: Do you go to school on foot or by bike?
sentences.chinese: 你走路还是骑自行车上学？

sentences.english: Every morning, I go to school with my older brother, and he always buys me a donut from the bakery on the way.
sentences.chinese: 每天早上我和哥哥一起去上学，他总会在路上面包店给我买一个甜甜圈。
sentences.scene: 和哥哥一起上学的温馨习惯

sentences.english: Let's go home now.
sentences.chinese: 我们现在回家吧。

sentences.english: After the movie, we walked home together in the dark.
sentences.chinese: 看完电影，我们摸黑一起走回家。

sentences.english: I was so tired after the long practice that all I wanted was to go home, take a hot shower, and crawl into bed.
sentences.chinese: 长时间训练后我累坏了，只想回家冲个热水澡，爬上床睡觉。
sentences.scene: 疲惫训练后渴望回家的舒适

sentences.english: It's time to go to bed.
sentences.chinese: 该睡觉了。

sentences.english: I usually go to bed at ten, but tonight I can stay up late.
sentences.chinese: 我通常十点睡觉，但今晚可以熬夜。
sentences.scene: 因特殊原因被允许晚睡

sentences.english: When I was little, my dad would read me a story before I went to bed, and I'd always ask for one more chapter.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候，爸爸总在睡前给我读故事，我总会要求再读一章。
sentences.scene: 回忆睡前故事的温馨时光

sentences.english: I want a puppy.
sentences.chinese: 我想要一只小狗。
sentences.scene: 向父母表达养宠物的愿望

sentences.english: Do you want to come to the park with us later?
sentences.chinese: 你待会儿想和我们一起去公园吗？

sentences.english: I really want to learn how to play the piano, so I'm going to ask my parents for lessons for my birthday.
sentences.chinese: 我真的很想学弹钢琴，所以打算生日时求爸妈让我上钢琴课。

sentences.english: The clock on the wall is broken.
sentences.chinese: 墙上的钟坏了。

sentences.english: I kept looking at the clock during the meeting because it was so boring.
sentences.chinese: 会议太无聊了，我不停地看时钟。
sentences.scene: 在无聊会议中期盼结束

sentences.english: My grandmother has an old grandfather clock that chimes every hour, and I love the sound because it reminds me of her house.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶有一座老式落地钟，每小时都会敲响，我喜欢那声音，因为它让我想起她的家。
sentences.scene: 奶奶家的钟声唤起温暖回忆

sentences.english: I just got home.
sentences.chinese: 我刚到家。

sentences.english: Can you wait a moment? I just need to grab my jacket.
sentences.chinese: 你能等一会儿吗？我只是去拿件外套。
sentences.scene: 准备出门时发现忘带外套

sentences.english: I wasn't really angry; I was just tired and hungry, and I said some things I didn't mean.
sentences.chinese: 我不是真的生气，我只是又累又饿，说了一些无心的话。
sentences.scene: 事后解释之前情绪不好的原因

sentences.english: Wait a minute, please.
sentences.chinese: 请稍等片刻。
sentences.scene: 需要短暂等待时请对方稍候

sentences.english: I'll be ready in a minute; I'm almost done with my hair.
sentences.chinese: 我马上就好，头发快弄完了。
sentences.scene: 出门前在卫生间回应催促

sentences.english: The train will arrive in five minutes, so we have just enough time to grab a coffee from the station café.
sentences.chinese: 火车五分钟后到站，所以我们的时间刚好够在车站咖啡店买杯咖啡。
sentences.scene: 赶车前抓紧时间买咖啡
